name: Martin Klenk
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2026)
forbes_bio: Martin Klenk is cofounder and CTO of enterprise software startup Celonis.
The Munich-based company was valued by private investors at $13 billion in 2022. Klenk owns a 16% stake.
The company disputes Forbes' valuation, which accounts for the downturn in private markets since the company's last funding round.
Klenk's cofounders Bastian Nominacher and Alexander Rinke are also billionaires. Nominacher and Rinke serve as co-CEOs.
Celonis' cofounders launched the company in 2011 after graduating from Technical University of Munich.

name: John Christodoulou
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2023-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: John Christodoulou is the founder and owner of the Yianis Group, a London-based real estate firm with properties in the U.K. and Europe.
Born in Cyprus, he fled the country with his family after the Turkish invasion of the island in 1974 and resettled in the U.K.
He dropped out of school at age 16 and worked as a diamond mounter, using his early profits to buy his first property: a studio apartment in London.
The Yianis Group's portfolio includes residential, retail, office and hotel properties, including two five-star hotels in London's Canary Wharf.
The Monaco resident still maintains close ties with his birth country and his Yianis Christodoulou Foundation supports children's education in Cyprus.
forbes_facts: John is a nickname; his full name is Yianakis Theophani Christodoulou.
He owns a 245-foot-yacht, Zeus, which features decks made of teak wood.

name: Joe Agresti
forbes_bio: Joe Agresti sells 20,000 Mercedes-Benzes a year through Dream Motor Group, the dealership chain he owns alongside legendary football coach Nick Saban.
Agresti grew up in working-class New Jersey, studied accounting at Rutgers on a partial wrestling scholarship, then did stints at Big Six firm Arthur Andersen and auto dealer giant Asbury Automotive.
At age 31, he used his $200,000 life savings, a mortgage against his parents' house and a $500,000 loan to invest in his first car dealership, Mercedes-Benz of Baton Rouge.
He met Saban through Mercedes in 2013. They now runs nine Merecedes, Infiniti and Ferrari dealership locations in Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Tennessee and Texas.
He splits his time traveling between homes he keeps near all his dealerships.
Agresti oversees the day-to-day operations and owns majority stakes in the dealerships, though Saban is a full minority partner. The two speak upwards of three times a day.
forbes_facts: Agresti has worked with Senator Bernie Moreno to help shape automotive policy and says he might one day run for federal office himself.
Agresti, Saban and their third partner, former Mercedes-Benz USA CEO Steve Cannon, own a fledgling Kentucky distillery, Slow Pass Bourbon.

name: Dariusz Milek
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Poland's "King of Shoes," Dariusz Milek created CCC, one of the biggest footwear retailers in Europe.
The CCC chain, which went public in 2004, has 980 shops in 23 countries.
In 2018, Miłek took over the number two shoe company in Switzerland and formed a joint venture with a German footwear retailer.
CCC also sells shoes online in 19 EU markets through eobuwie.pl.
Milek was a member of Poland's national youth cycling team and now owns CCC Cycling Group.

name: Wijono Tanoko
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023-2024); Forbes annual (2022-2024); Hurun Global (2022)
forbes_bio: Siblings Wijono and Hermanto Tanoko control Avia Avian, reportedly Indonesia's second-largest domestic paint company.
The company was founded in 1978 by their father Soetikno Tanoko.
Under Hermanto, the group has expanded into consumer goods, property and retail.
The brothers took the company public in 2021.
forbes_facts: Wijono is a serious art collector and has one of the world's finest collection of works by noted Chinese artist Wu Guanzhong.

name: Ana Maria Brescia Cafferata
name_chinese: 安娜·玛丽亚·布雷西亚·卡费拉塔
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2013-2023); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Wikidata (2021)
forbes_bio: She owns 30% of Grupo Breca, a Peruvian holding company with interests in agriculture, finance, hotels, mining and real estate.
She inherited her fortune from her father, Fortunato Brescia Tassano (d.1951), who built a real estate company that capitalized on Lima's growth.
Her assets were managed by her brothers Mario and Pedro until they passed away in 2013 and 2014, respectively.
Grupo Breca owns Tasa, one of the largest producers of fish meal in the world.
forbes_facts: Nonagenarian Brescia Cafferata never married and doesn't have any children.
Her father Fortunato, born in a poor family, married Catalina Cafferata Pe?aranda, a mining heiress and a daughter of the Italian consul in the city of Huaraz.

name: Ye Fan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2023); Hurun Global (2020-2023); Hurun China (2020-2023)
forbes_bio: Ye Fan is founder and chairman of Meidong Auto, a luxury auto dealership.
Brands sold by Meidong include Porsche, Lexus, Toyota and Hyundai.
Ye holds an undergraduate degree in inorganic non-metallic materials from South China University of Technology.

name: Taichiro Motoe
forbes_bio: Taichiro Motoe founded the predecessor to Bengo4.com in 2005, after working at white-shoe law firm Anderson Mori & Tomotsune.
Bengo4.com offers lawyer and accountant search and electronic signature services called CloudSign.
In 2016, Motoe won an Upper House seat in Japan's Parliament and is currently parliamentary vice minister of finance.
He stepped down as CEO, becoming chairman in 2017, but left the chairmanship in 2020.
forbes_facts: Motoe was born in Illinois but grew up in Kanagawa prefecture near Tokyo.
The name Bengo4 is a play on the Japanese word for 'lawyer', pronounced as 'bengoshi' .
